verdict.rationale: The pack documents no platform-wide hard spending cap for Vercel hosting or compute. The pricing docs say only that Vercel charges per unit once included usage or credit is used. The AI Gateway's 'budgets' and 'spending controls' cover only AI model request spend, which is an adjacent feature rather than hard limits on overall cloud costs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs
